The figure below schematically shows layers of different information for a certain area. After the subway is completed and put into operation, land prices around the stations will rise accordingly, but the land prices after rising will be very difficult to exceed 50. Read the figure and answer:

<image1>

Which location in the figure is the commercial center of this area most likely to be located at?

method.method_draft: First align the parcel, land-price, and proposed-subway layers cell by cell. For each labeled candidate, read its present land price and whether it is close to a subway station. Apply the text rule that subway-adjacent prices may rise but will hardly exceed 50. Since the 甲 cell corresponds to the only/clearest maximum land-price value 50 and is also near subway accessibility, while other candidates start below 50 and cannot rise above it, choose 甲 as the most likely commercial center.

推理：将三个图层逐格对应，甲所在格为第4行第1列，现有地价为50，是图中最高值，并且靠近拟建地铁站点。乙所在格现有地价为10，虽靠近站点，但题干说明地铁建成后站点周边地价会涨、但很难超过50，因此乙即使上涨也难超过甲。丙所在格现有地价为15，丁所在格现有地价为30，均低于50，且不比甲更具最高地价优势。商业中心通常最可能位于地价最高、交通可达性强的位置，因此该区域商业中心最可能位于甲。
